messages.author: Antigravity
messages.content:
Received **Issue #2** from your iPhone and redesigned **hellyeah** (`v0.3.0`) for native iPhone ergonomics:

- **Single-Row Sticky iOS Header**: Compact frosted-glass top bar with thumb-friendly `Bridge`, `Log`, and `Theme` pills.
- **Inline iOS Composer Bar**: Sleek 1-row prompt input (`16px` no-zoom) with an inline **Evolve** button right at the top.
- **Swipeable Suggestions Carousel**: Replaced the tall stacked grid with a horizontal touch-swipeable pill carousel (`scroll-snap-type: x mandatory`).
- **Collapsible Chat History**: Added a **Chat History** toggle so you can collapse messages whenever you want maximum stage space.

suggestions.title: Pomodoro & Focus Deck
suggestions.description: Tactile timer & task queue optimized for iPhone.
suggestions.prompt: Evolve the stage into a Personal Command Deck with a tactile Pomodoro focus timer and task queue.

suggestions.title: Touch XY Audio Synth
suggestions.description: Playable WebAudio synth pad with multi-touch chords.
suggestions.prompt: Add a playable WebAudio synthesizer and XY expression pad with preset chords.

suggestions.title: Bottom Tab Navigation Bar
suggestions.description: Add a native iOS bottom tab bar to switch between Stage, Chat, and Log.
suggestions.prompt: Add a sticky iOS bottom tab bar to switch cleanly between Chat, Stage, and Code Log.

suggestions.title: Quick Voice / Note Cards
suggestions.description: Capture spatial thought cards that persist on your phone.
suggestions.prompt: Build an interactive spatial note-taking board where I can create and link thought cards.

changelog.summary: Mobile-first redesign: single-row sticky frosted header, inline iOS composer bar, horizontal swipeable suggestions carousel, and 42px+ touch targets.
Moved Evolution Chat Console (#antigravity-console) and prompt input to the top of the app across all modes.
Initialized hellyeah core with SSE hot-reload, Antigravity file-bridge, suggestion engine, and modular stage.
